title: Minimax AUC Fairness: Efficient Algorithm With Provable Convergence
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical optimization of AUC-based fairness metrics using a minimax framework motivated by the Rawlsian principle of distributive justice. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as subjects of study, but rather uses a philosophical principle to define a loss function for algorithmic fairness in general machine learning.
